name: 30 oz Nurse Tumbler with Handle, Lid and Straw
seoTitle: 30 oz Nurse Tumbler with Handle and Straw
metaDescription: A 30 oz vacuum insulated nurse tumbler with a handle, lid, and straw. Holds enough water or coffee to get a nurse through a long 12 hour shift.
summary: A big 30 oz insulated tumbler with a handle, lid, and straw. A practical gift for nurses who struggle to stay hydrated on long shifts.
whyItWorks: Ask nurses what they forget to do on a busy shift and drinking water is usually near the top of the list. A 30 oz tumbler means fewer trips to the water fountain and a better chance they actually finish it. The vacuum insulation keeps iced water cold or coffee warm while it sits at the nurses station between patient rooms.

The handle is a bigger deal than it sounds. Nurses carry a lot from the car to the unit, often a lunch bag, a backpack, and sometimes a stethoscope looped around the neck, so being able to hook a finger through a handle helps. The lid and straw make sipping quick between tasks, and the travel mug design fits the commute in and out. Give it to a nurse starting a new job, a nursing student heading into clinicals, or anyone working long shifts. It is useful from day one, which is the best kind of nurse gift.
goodToKnow: Check the listing for whether it fits in a car cup holder, since large tumblers with handles vary.
Confirm on the listing whether the lid is leak resistant if it will ride in a bag.
Look at the photos to see whether it has a nurse design or is plain.

faq.q: Is 30 oz too big for work?
faq.a: Many nurses prefer a large tumbler because refills are hard to fit into a busy shift. Check that the unit allows drinks with lids at the station.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes. Clinical days are long, and a big tumbler helps students stay hydrated and caffeinated.
